final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(CASE WHEN CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE <> 0 AND "T-BIL" IS NOT NULL THEN "T-BIL" / CRE END) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_status_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT CENTROMEA, avg_hgb, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / mean_status_ratio AS ratio_vs_status_mean FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE mean_status_ratio IS NOT NULL
